summary: Rotate refresh token and obtain new access/refresh cookie pair
description: Consumes the current refresh-token cookie, rotates the token family, and sets new httpOnly Access and Refresh cookies. If a previously-used refresh token is replayed, the entire token family is revoked (replay detection).

200.description: Tokens rotated successfully. New Access and Refresh cookies are set.

401.description: Refresh token missing, invalid, expired, or replayed (family revoked)
